metadata.note: Validation-mode only, data-only. SXBET-only node that opens the SX.bet Centrifugo realtime feed (order_book_transport=stream) as the primary quote source with the REST poll loop as automatic fallback. Execution is disabled and structurally unarmed (validation_mode forces auto_execute=false and builds no execution client; venue execution_enabled=false). Bounded to baseball+tennis with a 48h horizon and instrument_load_limit=100 so quote subscriptions stay under the current ~120 cap, keeping the streamed-vs-polled comparison clean before the cap is raised.
metadata.stream_transport: SX.bet realtime is Centrifugo (not Ably). The stream client authenticates with the venue API key to fetch a realtime token, then subscribes order_book:market_{marketHash} channels. realtime_ws_url is unset and defaults to the mainnet endpoint wss://realtime.sx.bet/connection/websocket.
metadata.credentials: allow_dummy_credentials=true keeps the manifest buildable without secrets; streaming needs a real SXBET_API_KEY/SXBET_API_KEYS in the deploy environment (the strategy-node-release runner provides it). Without a real key the realtime-token fetch fails and the node degrades to REST poll, so confirm stream health from the node logs after deploy.
